scope: embedding/ vector search, production Parquet and sample JSONL paths
analysis_type: read-mostly static architecture and risk analysis

findings.confirmed_documentation_mismatch: README and COMMENTS describe GPU-accelerated FAISS search, while the search code constructs a direct faiss.IndexFlatIP and does not transfer it to GPU.
operational_risks: each search process rebuilds a fresh full in-memory index
export/query model identity and task compatibility are not represented in the Parquet schema
no representative relevance or full-scale resource benchmark is covered by the focused tests

verification.ruff: passed for reviewed embedding and test Python modules

limitations: No production Elasticsearch export or full-corpus Faiss index was opened.
No Jina model was downloaded or run.
The skill-linked analysis policy and research pitfall reference files were absent from the installed skill directories.
